resources.string: Le plugin ayi ayina umsebenzi we-render().
Le plugin in-id engeyona evumelekile. I-id inobude obungama-3 kuye kwangama-64. I-id ingaqukatha izinhlamvu ezincane, izinombolo, amachashazi, imigqa, kanye nokudwetshelwa.
“%1$s” iqukethe ikhodi ye-Lua ehlanganisiwe. I-plugin kumele isebenzise ikhodi yomthombo elula, ukuze ukwazi ukuyifunda ngaphambi kokuba isebenze.
Le plugin idinga inguqulo entsha ye-WM Keyboard.
Le nguqulo ye-WM Keyboard ayikwazi imvume ethi \"%1$s\". Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukukutshela ukuthi yini evunyelwe ukwenziwa ethi \"%2$s\".
Le plugin ithathe isikhathi eside kakhulu. Uhlelo lokusebenza luyimisiwe.
Le plugin yenze umsebenzi omningi kakhulu ngesikhathi esisodwa. Uhlelo lokusebenza luyimisiwe.
Le plugin iyekile ukuphendula. Uhlelo lokusebenza luyivalile.
Le plugin iyekile ukuphendula futhi. Uhlelo lokusebenza luyicimile.
Le plugin izibize kaningi kakhulu. Uhlelo lokusebenza luyimise.
Uhlu lwama-widget luqukethe okuthile okungewona i-widget.
Le plugin icele ukudweba umbhalo omningi kakhulu. Uhlelo lokusebenza lushiye eminye.
Umbhalo othile ubumude kakhulu ukuba ungadwetshwa. Uhlelo lokusebenza luwufushanisile.
Amanye amawijethi abekwe ngokujula kakhulu ukuze adwetshwe.
Le plugin icele ama-widget angaphezu kuka-%1$d. Uhlelo lokusebenza lulahle okusele.
Lokhu kwakhiwa akukwazi uhlobo lwe-widget ethi %1$s.
